The report describes a client, a Linux-hosted server, loader bots and plugins for remote command line access, process injection, credential theft, screenshots and network enumeration. Carbanak is reused as a backdoor. The authors say Lizar is still under development and is mostly used against victims in the United States. FIN7 is also reported to have attacked organisations in Germany and Panama and in several other sectors.

25d1e0f161e755fb43a986a32487aaeaf06aa589.summary: Mandiant reports a July 2023 supply chain compromise of a US-based software solutions entity, believed to have started with spear phishing against the JumpCloud directory platform. It attributes the activity to UNC4899, a suspected North Korean actor it assesses as a cryptocurrency-focused element of the Reconnaissance General Bureau. The intrusions deployed macOS backdoors FULLHOUSE.DOORED, STRATOFEAR and TIEDYE. The report also describes DPRK targeting of cryptocurrency and fintech executives and the groups' use of relay boxes and VPNs.
